{{Top|leg}}
'''Core Founder''' was the term given to one of the founding worlds of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which were all located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].

==History==
They included political players, and other important worlds, to the military, commerce, medical, diplomatic, and philosophical fields. Among others, the known founder worlds were [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]], [[Axum]], [[Bezha Two]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]], [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], [[Shawken]], and [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> with [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] and [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] being possible founders.

"Core Founder" was also the term given to those founding fathers of the Old Republic. All of them [[Human/Legends|Human]], they were immortalized in the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|Avenue of the Core Founders]] on Coruscant.<ref name="ITWOSWEI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> The [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]], the [[House Kuat]],<ref name="OK">{{DB|character|onarakuat|Kuat, Onara}}</ref> the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]],<ref name="TP">{{DB|character|tannonpraji|Praji, Tannon}}</ref> and the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]<ref name="TOR" /> were descended from the Core Founders.
